title: Privacy Policy
intro: This policy describes our information practices for visitors in the US, EU, and worldwide.

sections.heading: Data We Collect
paragraphs: We do not collect customer account data on this site. Visitors can browse, discover Akan names, and use public features without creating a user account. Admin access is restricted to Mama Africa only.

sections.heading: How We Use Data
paragraphs: Until you accept analytics cookies, Google Analytics tags do not load and analytics_storage stays denied (Consent Mode). Where you grant consent, limited non-personal analytics events may be used to improve site performance and conversion flow. We do not sell personal data.

sections.heading: EU & UK Rights
paragraphs: If you are in the EU/UK, you may request details about any personal data you submit directly via support communications and request deletion where applicable.
